disclaimer: DISCLAIMER: ECDAT provides evidence-based automated mapping of discovered cryptographic assets against published standards and guidance. ECDAT does not issue formal regulatory certification, accredited laboratory validation (e.g., NIST CMVP/CAVP), or statutory compliance attestation. Technical control verdicts represent automated evidence matches against documented criteria.

standards.name: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5: Security and Privacy Controls for Information Systems and Organizations
standards.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
standards.description: Comprehensive security and privacy control catalog for federal and enterprise information systems.

controls.title: Cryptographic Key Establishment and Management
controls.description: Establish and manage cryptographic keys for required cryptography employed in the system.
controls.manual_audit_guidance: Verify manual key split-knowledge procedures and physical access to hardware security modules.

controls.title: Cryptographic Protection
controls.description: Employ FIPS-validated cryptography and approved algorithms in accordance with applicable federal laws, executive orders, directives, and standards.
automated_evidence_sources: Binary symbol and library package cataloging
controls.manual_audit_guidance: Verify formal CAVP/CMVP validation module certificate numbers with vendors.

controls.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
controls.description: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of transmitted information using strong network encryption protocols.
controls.manual_audit_guidance: Inspect external network boundary firewall rules and VPN gateway administrative settings.

controls.title: Protection of Information at Rest
controls.description: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of information at rest located on databases, storage volumes, and user devices.
automated_evidence_sources: Static analysis of database column encryption wrappers
controls.manual_audit_guidance: Verify disk-level LUKS/BitLocker encryption, cloud KMS customer-managed key configuration, and physical tape storage security.

controls.title: Authenticator Management
controls.description: Manage information system authenticators including passwords, tokens, certificates, and biometrics.
automated_evidence_sources: Password hashing algorithm identification (e.g. bcrypt/argon2 vs MD5)
controls.manual_audit_guidance: Conduct review of employee identity proofing procedures and multi-factor authentication enrollment policies.

controls.title: Physical Access Control
controls.description: Enforce physical access authorizations to facilities containing hardware security modules, servers, and data centers.
controls.manual_audit_guidance: Audit facility badge access logs, biometric entry systems, security guard sign-in sheets, and physical server rack lock mechanisms. This control is out-of-scope for software discovery.

standards.name: NIST CNSA 2.0: Commercial National Security Algorithm Suite 2.0
standards.description: Post-quantum cryptographic mandates for National Security Systems and high-assurance critical infrastructure.

controls.title: Post-Quantum General Encryption and Key Establishment
controls.description: Mandates ML-KEM (FIPS 203) for post-quantum key encapsulation and hybrid key exchange in transit.
automated_evidence_sources: Detection of FIPS 203 ML-KEM parameters in library calls
TLS 1.3 hybrid key exchange group negotiation
controls.manual_audit_guidance: Verify that firmware and embedded cryptographic modules support post-quantum key sizes.

controls.title: Post-Quantum Digital Signatures
controls.description: Mandates ML-DSA (FIPS 204) or SLH-DSA (FIPS 205) for software/firmware signing, PKI, and digital signatures.
controls.manual_audit_guidance: Inspect offline root CA signing procedures and hardware tokens for PQC signature support.

controls.title: Symmetric Block Encryption Strength
controls.description: Mandates AES-256 for symmetric data protection to defend against Grover's quantum search algorithm.
automated_evidence_sources: Symmetric cipher key length parameter inspection
TLS cipher suite bit strength derivation
controls.manual_audit_guidance: Confirm that storage systems and hardware encryptors utilize 256-bit symmetric keys.

controls.title: Cryptographic Hashing Strength
controls.description: Mandates SHA-384 or SHA-512 for quantum-safe collision resistance.
controls.manual_audit_guidance: Review legacy integration points for hash algorithm compatibility.

standards.name: PCI DSS v4.0: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard
standards.description: Information security standard for entities that store, process, or transmit cardholder data.

controls.title: Protect Cryptographic Keys Against Disclosure and Misuse
controls.description: Cryptographic keys used for cardholder data encryption must be protected against unauthorized access and disclosure.
automated_evidence_sources: Hardcoded private key detection in source code and binaries
controls.manual_audit_guidance: Manually verify dual control and split knowledge procedures for manual key handling and KMS access permissions.

controls.title: Key Management Procedures for Strong Cryptography
controls.description: Implement key management procedures including key generation, distribution, secure storage, and scheduled rotation.
automated_evidence_sources: Certificate validity and rotation period verification
controls.manual_audit_guidance: Review written key management policies, annual key custodian sign-off, and key retirement records.

controls.title: Strong Cryptography for Cardholder Data in Transit
controls.description: Protect cardholder data during transmission over open, public networks using strong cryptography and secure protocols.
automated_evidence_sources: Perimeter TLS endpoint protocol version extraction
controls.manual_audit_guidance: Verify network perimeter architectural diagrams and wireless payment gateway encryption posture.

controls.title: Physical Security Controls to Cardholder Data Environment
controls.description: Appropriate facility entry controls are in place to limit and monitor physical access to systems in the CDE.
controls.manual_audit_guidance: Inspect video surveillance, physical locks, visitor access logs, and security alarms at payment data centers. This control is out-of-scope for software discovery.

standards.name: NIST SP 800-131A Rev 2: Transitioning the Use of Cryptographic Algorithms and Key Lengths
standards.description: Guidance on transitional schedules for cryptographic algorithms and minimum key lengths.

controls.title: Symmetric Algorithm Strength Transitions
automated_evidence_sources: Static and runtime symmetric cipher identification
controls.manual_audit_guidance: Review legacy batch processing encryption routines.

controls.title: Asymmetric Algorithm Key Length Transitions
controls.description: Disallows RSA < 2048, ECC < 224, DSA < 2048; approves RSA >= 2048, ECC >= 224, DH >= 2048.
automated_evidence_sources: Certificate and private key bit size extraction
controls.manual_audit_guidance: Verify hardware token key length capabilities.

controls.title: Secure Hash Algorithm Digital Signature Transition
controls.description: Disallows SHA-1 for digital signature generation; requires SHA-2 or SHA-3.
controls.manual_audit_guidance: Verify digital signature verification policies on legacy archive documents.

standards.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Information Security Management Systems
standards.description: International standard for managing information security risks.

controls.title: Use of Cryptography
controls.description: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, shall be defined and implemented.
automated_evidence_sources: Automated policy-as-code evaluation against ISO cryptographic profile
Inventory of active algorithms and key lengths
controls.manual_audit_guidance: Review documented organization-wide cryptographic policy manual.

controls.title: Policies for Information Security
controls.description: Information security policy and topic-specific policies shall be defined, approved by management, published, communicated to and acknowledged by relevant personnel.
controls.manual_audit_guidance: Review corporate policy repository, management board minutes, and employee training acknowledgement records. This control is out-of-scope for software discovery.
